description: CUR-ID, variant: how does the 4-byte Bookmark encode row ordinals beyond 255? A dynaset on Big, a table-type recordset on Big without Index and one with Index PK_Big each read Bookmark (and ID) at rows 1, 255 (Move 254), 256, 257, 1000 and 2048 (MoveLast).
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
